definitions.data: scripts/perimage_v6.py load(); duplicates removed; units = photograph for Medetec and AZH (incl. control), image otherwise
definitions.agreement: Spearman (Pearson on average ranks) of per-method mean scores between two datasets over a method set
definitions.pairs: 55 pairs of the 11 REFS; same modality 16 (of which 3 within source: fuseg~azh, kvasir_disjoint~kvasir_sessile, cvc_clinicdb~cvc_colondb; 13 different source), across modality 39; control = azh vs azh_train_slice
definitions.modality_diff: mean same-modality pair agreement (16) minus mean across-modality agreement (39)
definitions.modality_diff_excl_within_source: mean of the 13 different-source same-modality pairs minus mean of the 39 across-modality pairs; relabeling test drops the 3 within-source pairs by identity (52 pairs)
